charts.question: The primary effect is estimated within participant
charts.supported_finding: Paired fixation-duration differences preserve the repeated-measures design and display participant-bootstrap uncertainty.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The contrast is specific to this sample, task, and measurement protocol.

charts.question: Multiplicity changes how the outcome family is read
charts.supported_finding: Primary and secondary outcomes are shown together after sign-flip inference and Holm adjustment.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Statistical separation does not establish a downstream educational or policy benefit.

charts.question: Additional contrast carries an assessment-time cost
charts.supported_finding: The protocol comparison places group separation beside measurement burden so neither outcome is optimized in isolation.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The value placed on burden versus separation is a stakeholder judgment, not a property of the dataset.
